title: Kim Kardashian's Skims Beauty is coming next year, but can it survive in the current market?
summary: Kim Kardashian is banking on her upcoming Skims Beauty launch in 2027 being a success. But can the celebrity mogul's latest beauty venture stick the landing in what is beauty’s most competitive era?

extraction.key_fact: 킴 카다시안이 내년에 Skims Beauty를 선보일 예정이다.
